title: Intermittent order create — api-gateway hitting client timeouts to payment-api
symptoms: end-to-end latency dominated by waiting on a dependency
read/connect timeouts naming a downstream host
circuit breaker or retry storms toward one dependency
observed_signals: downstream_latency_ms on the caller rose toward the configured client timeout
caller CPU and memory stayed close to baseline
retries increased request rate slightly without a user-traffic surge
db utilization rose only where the caller held connections during the wait

timeline.event: synthetic checks to payment-api were still green
outbound p95 from api-gateway toward payment-api rose
circuit breaker or retry logs referenced payment-api
payment-api recovered or was isolated; caller errors receded

contributing_factors: payment-api was degraded in one region
api-gateway timeout was tight relative to the provider p99
resolution: confirmed payment-api latency on the provider status page and their dashboards
raised the client timeout only after proving the dependency was the bottleneck
enabled a circuit breaker and a cached fallback for non-critical reads
lessons_learned: distinguish caller CPU/memory (flat) from outbound latency (up)
fallback and circuit breaking should be tested, not only documented
